results.reasoning: ECC supplies skills, hooks, instincts, memory, and security tooling installed as plugins into external agent harnesses like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, rather than being a standalone agentic application.
Hermes Agent is a complete self-improving LLM agent with tools, persistent memory, skills, session search, and a multi-platform messaging gateway for executing multi-step tasks.
Dify is a complete LLM app platform with visual agent workflows, RAG pipelines, model management and tool integration for multi-step tasks, deployable as a full application.
Claude Code is a complete LLM-powered terminal coding agent using tools and codebase retrieval to plan and execute multi-step tasks, also shipping plugins and commands.
The repository includes many complete, runnable LLM agent and RAG apps (e.g., travel agent, fraud investigation agent) using tools and retrieval for multi-step tasks, alongside skills and templates.

Browser Use is an open-source LLM-driven browser agent (Python library, CLI, hosted agent API) that plans and executes multi-step web tasks using browser tools, so it qualifies despite also shipping a benchmark and integrations.
Gemini CLI is a complete open-source terminal AI agent integrating Gemini with built-in tools (file ops, shell, web search), MCP extensibility, and context memory to execute multi-step tasks.
claude-mem is a plugin/infrastructure that captures, compresses, and injects memory into external agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, rather than being a standalone agentic application.

A complete local-first design workspace app that drives coding agents and LLMs through skills, design systems and tools to plan and produce multi-step design artifacts with export, beyond being a plain wrapper.

A complete dashboard app that uses LLMs (Ollama/OpenRouter) to synthesize aggregated news feeds into briefs and correlate cross-stream signals, fitting a complete LLM app with retrieval; recall priority favors inclusion.
LobeHub is a complete self-hostable multi-agent platform that integrates LLMs with plugins, memory, and knowledge retrieval so agents can create, schedule, and collaborate on multi-step tasks.
DeerFlow is a complete super-agent harness application integrating LLMs with sub-agents, memory, sandboxes, tools and skills to plan and execute long-horizon multi-step research and coding tasks.

Paperclip is a complete Node.js and React orchestration app that coordinates teams of LLM agents through goals, delegation, heartbeats, budgets and governance to run multi-step work, which goes beyond a thin wrapper.
Repository delivers portable Agent Skills (SKILL.md files) installed via npx for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor; no standalone agentic application is included.
Unsloth Studio/Desktop is a complete app that runs LLMs with tool calling, code execution, web search, deep research and RAG, alongside its training tooling.

OmO is a standalone coding agent (native omo binary) with multi-agent orchestration, git-based memory (Kibitzer), multi-model routing, and planning/verification of multi-step tasks, making it a complete agentic application.
AnythingLLM is a complete app integrating LLMs with RAG, memory, MCP tools, and agents (web browsing, scheduled tasks, agent flows) to execute multi-step tasks.

Cherry Studio is a complete desktop app integrating LLMs with MCP tools, knowledge retrieval, and autonomous agents/assistants for multi-step tasks, so it qualifies under rule 1 despite being a multi-provider chat client.

An end-to-end agentic video production system: pipelines, 100+ tools, web research, and self-review run multi-step tasks through the user's coding assistant, so it counts as a complete application despite the host-agent dependence.
CowAgent is a complete LLM-based assistant that plans multi-step tasks, uses tools and skills, has memory and knowledge retrieval, and supports multi-agent teams across channels.
Orca is a desktop/mobile environment that runs and monitors external coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode) in parallel worktrees, rather than being an agent itself.
Besides the MCP tooling for external agents, the Web UI ships an AI chat that queries the code knowledge graph to answer multi-step questions. By rule 1 and recall priority, this counts as agentic.
Repository is a collection of marketing skills (plus tool integration guides) installed into external coding agents like Claude Code and Codex; it is not itself a standalone agentic application.
LibreChat is a complete self-hosted multi-user chat platform integrating LLMs with agents, MCP tools, code interpreter, file search, and memory to execute multi-step tasks.

Complete multi-agent LLM public opinion analysis system with Query, Media, Insight, and Report agents using search tools, databases, and a forum mechanism to run multi-step analyses and generate reports.
AstrBot is a complete, deployable agent chatbot platform integrating LLMs with MCP, skills, knowledge base retrieval, plugins, and a sandbox for multi-step task execution across IM platforms.
Ships Agent TARS (CLI/Web UI multimodal agent with MCP tools and browser control) and UI-TARS-desktop, a native GUI agent app, both complete LLM-driven multi-step agentic applications.
Complete deployable RAG and Agent application using LLMs with knowledge-base retrieval, search engine and database tools, and agent capabilities, offering both API and WebUI.

PostHog is a full product analytics platform that ships LLM-powered features (Replay Vision, PostHog AI assistant, Slack/web/desktop agents) using tools and data retrieval for multi-step tasks, so it qualifies under rule 1.
AgentGPT is a complete web application where LLM-driven autonomous agents plan tasks, execute them with tools like search, and learn from results to reach user-defined goals.
Continue is a complete open-source coding agent shipped as a CLI, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin, integrating LLMs with tools and context to execute multi-step coding tasks.
Postiz is a full social media scheduling platform marketed as agentic, with many AI features and agent integrations; per recall priority and rule 1, it is classed as an agentic application.

ChatDev 2.0 is a complete multi-agent platform with backend and frontend where LLM agents run configurable workflows to execute multi-step tasks; the legacy 1.0 is also a software-development agent system.
OMX is a workflow layer that launches and augments OpenAI Codex CLI with hooks, team orchestration, a HUD and a mission queue runner, while Codex stays the execution engine.
AionUi ships a built-in agent engine with file I/O, web search, MCP tools, assistants, and cron automation, making it a complete agentic app beyond merely wrapping external CLI agents.
Complete multi-agent LLM application (FastAPI + Vue) with analyst agents debating, tool calling, web search, memory, and autonomous planning for A-share stock research.
Vibe-Trading is a complete LLM-driven trading research agent with multi-agent teams, market-data tools, persistent memory, backtesting, and CLI/Web UI, planning and executing multi-step tasks.
NanoClaw is a complete personal AI assistant running Claude agents in containers, with messaging channels, memory, scheduled multi-step tasks, and tool access, built on Anthropic's Agents SDK.
Self-hosted autonomous 'Dot' agent with its own VM, browser, memory, skills, and MCP tools that plans and executes multi-step tasks from natural-language requests; a complete agentic application.
Cognee is a memory platform and SDK (with CLI and integrations) that other agents use for persistent long-term memory via a knowledge graph, rather than a standalone agentic application.

Sim is a full workspace platform for building, deploying, and running LLM agents and workflows with integrations, knowledge bases (memory/retrieval), tools, and monitoring, delivered as cloud, self-hosted, and desktop apps.
FastGPT is a deployable AI agent-building platform integrating LLMs with RAG knowledge bases, MCP tools, and visual multi-step workflow orchestration, constituting a complete agentic application.
Nx is a conventional monorepo build system with caching and CI; AI-agent features are incidental optimizations for external agents, not a complete LLM-driven agentic application.

GPT Researcher is a complete autonomous research app where planner and execution agents use LLMs, web search, scraping, and memory to run multi-step research and produce reports, despite also shipping as a Claude Skill.
Page Agent is a complete in-page GUI agent that uses an LLM with DOM tools to plan and execute multi-step web tasks from natural language, with an optional extension and MCP server.

Mainly agent memory infrastructure (CLI/MCP, skills), but it also ships LLM-driven synthesis, gap analysis and background enrichment over retrieval, graph and memory stores, so it likely counts as a complete agentic system.

Budibase is a complete open-source platform with built-in LLM-powered agents that use tools and integrations to take multi-step actions like creating records and routing approvals, alongside apps and automations.
OpenCLI is a browser automation CLI, Chrome bridge extension, and installable skills that external agents like Claude Code use to operate websites; it is not itself an LLM agent.
Serena is an MCP toolkit providing semantic code retrieval, editing, and refactoring tools plus memory for external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) to use, rather than a standalone agent.
Dexter is a complete autonomous financial research agent using LLMs with task planning, tool execution for market data and web search, and self-validation across multi-step tasks.
Claude HUD is a status line plugin that displays context usage, tools, agents, and todos for Claude Code, acting as a presentation monitor around another agent.
Qwen Code is a complete LLM-powered coding agent with tools, memory, subagents, and MCP that plans and executes multi-step tasks across terminal, IDE, and other interfaces.
Kilo is a complete open-source coding agent (VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, cloud) integrating LLMs with terminal/browser tools, MCP servers, and multi-step planning and execution across files.
AgenticSeek is a complete local Manus-style assistant that uses LLMs with web browsing, code execution, and multi-agent planning to autonomously carry out multi-step tasks.
oh-my-pi is a complete standalone coding agent with LLM provider routing, 31 built-in tools, LSP/DAP integration, and web search, executing multi-step tasks, not a wrapper around another agent.
Roo Code is a complete VS Code AI coding agent that uses LLMs with tools, MCP servers, and modes to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks, despite being shut down.

Promptfoo is a complete CLI app whose red-teaming and code-scanning features use LLM attackers and graders to run multi-step, adaptive attack workflows against target apps, beyond being an eval harness.
Vanna 2.0 is a complete LLM agent app that uses user-aware SQL tools, memory and RAG enrichers to turn questions into SQL, tables and charts, with a built-in web UI.
Activepieces is a complete workflow automation platform with a builder, native AI agents and AI SDK, and pieces exposed as MCP servers, so it qualifies as an agentic application.
opcode is a Tauri desktop GUI around the external Claude Code CLI, covering session browsing, usage analytics, MCP management, and launching custom Claude Code agents, rather than a standalone agent.

Opik is an observability, evaluation and optimization platform with SDKs that other LLM apps and agents plug into, so it is infrastructure for external agents rather than a standalone agentic application.
OpenMAIC is a complete multi-agent platform where LLM-driven AI teachers and classmates generate and deliver interactive classrooms, with an agent runtime, tools, skills, and persistent sessions.

video-use is a skill symlinked into Claude Code or Codex skills directories, with helper scripts for transcription, timeline views, and rendering. The external coding agent does the planning and editing.
A skill/plugin (SKILL.md with 10 output rules) installed into external coding agents like Claude Code to change their response style; it is not a standalone agentic application.
OWL is a multi-agent framework with runnable examples and a web UI. It combines LLMs with search, browser automation, code execution, and MCP tools to plan and execute multi-step real-world tasks.
Hindsight is a memory server with SDKs, an MCP server and integrations that other agents plug into for retain, recall and reflect, so it is agent infrastructure rather than a standalone agentic app.

Tongyi DeepResearch ships a deep-research agent with inference scripts (ReAct and IterResearch Heavy modes) using search and browsing tools, plus online demos, so it is a complete agentic application alongside the model.
DB-GPT is a complete AI data assistant that connects LLMs to databases, writes SQL and code, runs skills in sandboxes, and generates reports via multi-step autonomous workflows.
A complete deep research agent that uses LLMs with search engines and web scraping to iteratively plan queries, process results, and generate markdown reports across multiple steps.
Easy-Vibe is primarily a multilingual online course on AI coding with interactive tutorials and learning maps; no evidence of a complete agentic application deliverable.
Unofficial Python API, CLI, MCP server and agent skill giving external agents like Claude Code and Codex programmatic access to NotebookLM; it is infrastructure for agents, not an agentic app itself.
Repository is a free AI knowledge base and Vibe Coding tutorial series with resource lists, guides, and course links; no complete agentic application is delivered.
Nuclear is a conventional desktop music player with plugins; its MCP server and skill are optional integrations for external agents, but the product itself has no LLM-driven agentic functionality.
DocsGPT is a complete self-hosted platform integrating LLMs with retrieval (RAG), tools, MCP, and workflows to build agents that run deep multi-step research and actions.
LangBot is a complete platform integrating LLMs with tool calling, RAG knowledge bases, plugins and MCP to run multi-step agent bots across IM platforms, with a web management panel.
Web UI client that presents and controls the separate Hermes Agent from browser or phone; it wraps another agent rather than implementing its own agent.

Complete PDF chatbot app using LangGraph with an LLM, Supabase vector retrieval, and a routing decision between retrieving or answering directly, plus a Next.js UI; it is a working application despite the template framing.

A complete multi-agent orchestration system with 12 LLM agents (planning, review, dispatch, execution), a real-time dashboard, and task management. It is built on OpenClaw but ships its own full application.

DeepCode is a complete multi-agent coding system with orchestrating, intent, document-parsing, and planning agents, plus CLI, desktop, and browser interfaces, that plans and executes multi-step coding tasks with tools.
A Gradio web UI that runs a complete LLM-driven browser agent (browser-use) with multi-provider LLM support, browser control, and persistent sessions to plan and execute multi-step web tasks.
SurfSense is a complete desktop app with an LLM agent that researches, creates and edits documents using retrieval, tools and multi-step workflows, so it is an agentic application.

A complete multi-agent investment research pipeline on Claude Code/Codex, with parallel adversarial analyst perspectives, Python verification tools, and generated reports. It is more than a skill collection, and recall favors inclusion.
OpenHarness is a complete agent harness with an agent loop, tools, memory and multi-agent coordination, and it ships ohmo, a full personal agent that works across chat platforms.
Complete web GUI app integrating LLMs with web search, file-based retrieval QA, and an AutoGPT-like 'Chuanhu Assistant' agent for multi-step tasks, so it qualifies as an agentic application.

OpenWiki ships a standalone CLI built on its own Deep Agents documentation agent that researches repositories and writes and updates wikis through multi-step durable page jobs, alongside coding-agent integrations.
PentestGPT is a complete autonomous penetration-testing agent that uses LLM backends (Claude Code, Codex) with tools to run a multi-stage pipeline (recon, exploit, report) against targets.
Primarily a CLI static-analysis security scanner with 71 patterns; the LLM semantic stage is optional and incidental, and the optional MCP mode is secondary, so it is not a multi-step agentic system.

memU is a memory system installed as a skill/adapter into host agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.), providing memorize and retrieve capabilities for other agents rather than a standalone agentic app.
A plugin of skills and sub-agents that runs inside Claude Code, an external agent, rather than a standalone agentic application.
Beyond the desktop client, it ships its own Claude Code-derived CLI/runtime with multi-model LLM support, MCP tools, subagents, Agent Teams, workflows and Computer Use for multi-step tasks.
Desktop GUI that installs, configures, and chats with the separate Hermes Agent; it is a presentation client and launcher around another agent rather than its own agent.
Paseo is a daemon plus desktop, mobile, web and CLI clients that present and orchestrate external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, etc.), rather than implementing its own LLM agent.
A self-hosted AI creative workspace with an Assistant that plans briefs and generates images and videos via LLM/model providers, with canvas, references, and project storage; a complete application.
Nanobrowser is a complete Chrome extension running a multi-agent (Planner/Navigator) LLM system that autonomously plans and executes multi-step web automation tasks in the browser.
QM is a complete multiplayer agent system with a core agent loop, Postgres memory, per-scope sandboxes, tools, crons, and Slack/web interfaces, using LLMs to execute multi-step tasks.
A plugin, skills library and local MCP server (cadgen) that gives external agents like Claude Code and Codex CAD capabilities, rather than being a standalone agentic app.
Fay is a complete digital-human agent framework integrating LLMs with tool calling (MCP), memory, knowledge base, and scheduled proactive dialogue, runnable as an application with a management UI.
Superset is a desktop workspace that hosts and orchestrates external CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex) with terminals, diff review, and browser previews, rather than being its own LLM agent.

InsForge is a backend platform (database, auth, storage, functions) that coding agents operate through an MCP server and CLI plus Skills; it is infrastructure for external agents, not an agent itself.
NoteGen is a complete local-first Markdown note app that integrates LLMs with knowledge-base retrieval, local search, and an Agent mode for multi-step tasks.
PR-Agent is a complete LLM-powered code review application that retrieves PR context from git providers and runs multi-step tools (describe, review, improve, ask) via GitHub Action, CLI, or app.
A complete voice-agent pipeline combining STT, an LLM, and TTS with a realtime server and clients, delivering conversational voice assistants as a runnable application, per recall-favoring rule.
Claude Context is an MCP server/plugin providing semantic code search over a vector database for external coding agents like Claude Code; it is not itself an agent.
Agent S is a complete open-source computer-use agent that uses LLMs with screen perception and GUI actions (mouse, keyboard) to plan and execute multi-step desktop tasks.
Trae Agent is a complete LLM-based CLI agent that uses tools (bash, file editing, sequential thinking) to plan and execute multi-step software engineering tasks.
Astryx is a React/StyleX design system with components, themes, and a CLI; it is agent-friendly but is conventional UI software, not an LLM-driven application.
BISHENG is a complete LLM application platform with workflow orchestration, RAG, agents, and the Lingsight general-purpose agent, integrating LLMs with tools and retrieval for multi-step tasks.
The repo delivers UI-TARS-1.5 vision-language model releases, deployment guidance and an action-parser package; the full desktop agent app lives in a separate repository.

A complete multi-platform IM bot that routes messages to LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Pi) with local chat/contact tools for auto-replies, group and friend analysis, which is an LLM-integrated application with tool access.
Kimi CLI is a complete terminal AI coding agent integrating an LLM with tools, MCP servers, and sessions to execute multi-step tasks, though now archived and replaced.

Bytebot is a complete self-hosted AI desktop agent that uses an LLM to see the screen, control mouse and keyboard in a containerized Linux desktop, and complete multi-step tasks, with a web UI and APIs.
It is primarily an MCP server exposing 150+ security tools for external LLM agents (Claude, GPT, Copilot) to drive. Its internal 'agents' are largely rule-based and don't clearly embed an LLM.
ValueCell is a complete multi-agent LLM application with DeepResearch, Strategy, and News agents using market data and trading tools, delivered as a desktop app with frontend and backend.
Mainly a conventional OSINT geospatial dashboard; the description mentions hooking up an AI agent, but the README shows no built-in LLM, tools or memory, so evidence is unclear.
Complete self-hosted AI trading platform integrating LLM-driven market research with strategy generation, backtesting, and paper/live execution tools, plus an Agent Gateway and MCP access.
Open SWE is a complete LLM-based coding agent built on Deep Agents/LangGraph that plans, uses sandbox tools, subagents, and GitHub integrations to implement changes and deliver pull requests.
Beyond wrapping Hermes, Claude Code and Codex, it ships its own Ekko Agent runtime, a global agent, workflows, memory, MCP tooling and task plans, making it a complete multi-agent app.

ego lite is a browser with an ego-browser skill that lets external agents like Codex or Claude Code run browser automation; it provides infrastructure for other agents rather than being an agent itself.

MagenticLite is a complete, installable agentic app pairing an orchestrator LLM with a browser-use model to plan and execute multi-step tasks across the browser and local file system, with human oversight.
It is an Agent Skill installed into Codex and Claude Code to generate diagrams; the skill is infrastructure for external agents rather than a standalone agentic application.
The repository is an awesome-list curating plugins, themes, agents, and resources for opencode, which is reference material and not a runnable agentic application.
PixelRAG is a full retrieval-augmented pipeline, with screenshot rendering, a hosted visual index and a VLM reader, so it counts as a research app; it also ships a Claude skill.
CodeBurn is a conventional local CLI/desktop analytics tool that parses session files from AI coding agents to report token usage and cost; it does not use LLMs itself.
Desktop Commander is an MCP server giving external AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT) terminal, file system, and editing tools; it has no LLM-driven agent of its own.

Mobile-Agent is a family of GUI agents (v3/v3.5) with runnable multi-step agent frameworks and live demos that operate phones and PCs, plus models and datasets; the complete agent app takes precedence.

InkOS is a complete LLM-based story creation agent system (pi-agent tool loop, memory/state, retrieval, review and revision) with Studio, TUI and CLI interfaces for multi-step novel and script production.
Visualizes and monitors Claude Code terminal agents as pixel-art characters in a VS Code extension or browser app; it is a presentation client around external agents, not an agent itself.

OpenChamber is a desktop, web, VS Code and mobile workspace built around the external OpenCode agent. Its goals, multi-run and walkthrough features add orchestration on top of that agent rather than a standalone agent.
Complete LLM-based Xianyu customer service bot with intent-routed expert agents, conversation memory, web search integration, and multi-step automated bargaining and replies.
A REST API browser server with anti-detection, accessibility snapshots, and element refs built for AI agents to use as a tool; it contains no LLM-driven agent itself.
XAgent is a complete LLM-driven autonomous agent that plans and executes multi-step tasks using a ToolServer for external tools, with a CLI and server/GUI, qualifying as an agentic application.
A complete CRM whose autonomous agent (built on eve) uses 18 tools, skills, a work queue and sandbox to research contacts and record evidence-backed facts over multi-step tasks.

Bindu is a framework/infrastructure layer (identity, communication, payments via bindufy) that other developers' agents plug into; it ships no standalone agentic application itself, only examples wrapping external agents.
Includes a complete research agent (miroflow-agent) that uses LLMs with web search, code execution tools, and multi-step task execution, plus released models; the agent app takes precedence.
Complete agent workspace with chat UI where LLM agents perform tasks using company context, build sandboxed apps (gadgets), and run under a Gatekeepers security framework.

The plugin ships a multi-agent suite (orchestrator, explorer, fixer) that delegates and plans multi-step tasks with LLMs and tools. It runs inside OpenCode, but the orchestration is its own agentic system, and recall is prioritized.
DeepSearcher is a complete deep-research application that combines LLMs with a vector database for retrieval and multi-step search, reasoning, and report generation over private data.
Complete self-hosted visual CMS that the description calls agentic; the README excerpt shows no LLM details, so this leans on the description and a recall-first approach.

ClawX is a desktop GUI and launcher around the OpenClaw agent runtime, handling setup, chat, provider configuration and gateway lifecycle. It presents another agent rather than being an original agentic system.
Deepsec is a complete CLI vulnerability scanner that uses LLM coding agents to autonomously study, scan, and review codebases in multi-step, resumable, parallel workflows, with its own tooling.
Voyager is a complete LLM-powered embodied agent in Minecraft using GPT-4 with an automatic curriculum, a skill library for retrieval, and iterative prompting to plan and execute multi-step tasks.
Craft Agents is a complete desktop app integrating LLMs (Claude Agent SDK, Pi SDK) with MCP tools, sources, skills, and permission modes to execute multi-step agentic tasks.
HolaOS is a complete workspace with its own built-in agent, memory, tools, integrations and MCP, executing multi-step tasks, while also hosting external agents like Claude Code and Codex.
AI Scientist-v2 is a complete end-to-end LLM-driven system that autonomously generates hypotheses, runs experiments via agentic tree search, analyzes results, and writes papers.
An MCP server, WebSocket relay, and Figma plugin that let external agents (Cursor, Claude Code) read and modify Figma designs; it contains no standalone LLM-driven application.
Complete pipeline using an LLM with PDF parsing, GitHub API retrieval, and multi-step project selection and evaluation to score resumes end to end via CLI.
An IDE extension with its own design agent that uses LLMs with tools to generate UI mockups, components, and wireframes from prompts, supporting multiple model providers; it is a complete app.
Self-hosted email client with a built-in LLM agent (Workers AI, Agents SDK) using 9 email tools to read, search, draft replies, and auto-draft on new email.
stagewise is a complete agentic IDE with a built-in coding agent that uses LLMs with tools such as browser console, debugger, and git to plan and perform multi-step coding tasks.
Markdown editor that integrates LLM AI Copilot and an OpenCode AI Agent for coding assistance; given recall priority for possible agentic apps, it qualifies as an agentic application.
Kimi Code CLI is a complete terminal AI coding agent using LLMs with tools, MCP servers, subagents, and file/shell access to plan and execute multi-step tasks.
Complete deployable call-center bot using Azure OpenAI GPT with tool calls, conversation memory, and claim/todo storage to conduct multi-step phone conversations autonomously.
A complete customer service demo app with a Python backend using the OpenAI Agents SDK for multi-agent triage, routing, and tool use, plus a Next.js chat UI.
Airweave is shared retrieval infrastructure (API, SDKs, MCP, CLI) that external agents query for context; it is not itself an agent that plans and executes multi-step tasks.
Streamlit app where a builder LLM agent generates a RAG agent with retrieval and summarization tools over user data, which users then query; a complete agentic application.

Jaaz is a complete local-first desktop app with an LLM-driven chat agent that uses image/video generation models and tools (ComfyUI, Ollama, cloud APIs) to plan and execute multi-step creative tasks on a canvas.
dev-browser is a CLI and installable skill that lets external coding agents control Chrome via Puppeteer scripts; it contains no LLM-driven agent of its own.
Deep reinforcement learning (PPO) game-playing agent with no LLM, tools, or retrieval; it is a non-LLM agent, so it falls under conventional software rather than agentic applications.

A desktop app bundling the Pi agent with market data tools, persistent workspaces, scheduled Issues and trading accounts for multi-step research and trading workflows, so it is a complete agentic application.
Backlog.md is a Markdown task manager/Kanban CLI with MCP support that external AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex) use for structuring work; it is not itself an agent.
A web workspace UI (chat, terminal, memory, skills, dashboard) that attaches to a separately installed Hermes Agent gateway, so it is a presentation client around another agent.
A complete desktop agent app that connects multiple LLM providers to MCP tools, skills, and memory for multi-step tasks, so it is more than a thin wrapper around another agent.
A complete Next.js deep research app where an LLM agent uses Firecrawl search and extract tools plus a reasoning model to plan and execute multi-step web research.
DeepChat is a complete desktop AI agent app integrating LLMs with MCP tools, Skills, memory/session tape, and ACP agents to execute multi-step tasks.

A pipeline engine and runtime that integrates LLMs with vector databases, tools, and agent orchestration to run multi-step AI workflows; it ships as a complete system with a VS Code extension and SDKs.
Repository is a curated collection of leaked or published system prompts plus a guide on prompt patterns for agentic AI; it is reference material, not a runnable application.
Kun is a complete local desktop/TUI agent workspace with its own runtime, LLM providers, memory, MCP/skills tools, approvals, and multi-step coding/writing/research tasks.
ZCF is a CLI that configures Claude Code and Codex with workflows, agents, MCP servers, and API settings; it extends external agents rather than being a standalone agentic app.
bb-browser is a CLI and MCP server with site adapters that lets external AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) control the user's real Chrome; it has no LLM-driven agent of its own.
HanaAgent is a complete desktop personal AI agent app integrating LLMs with memory, tools, skills, scheduling, and multi-agent collaboration to execute multi-step tasks.
Lightdash is a complete BI platform that includes built-in AI agents answering questions from a governed context layer, plus prompt-driven Data Apps, so it qualifies as an agentic application.
Repository is a Claude Code configuration showcase of hooks, skills, agents, commands, and workflows meant to extend an external agent (Claude Code), not a standalone agentic application.
A self-hosted dashboard and control plane for dispatching, monitoring, and governing external runtimes (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex); it explicitly does not replace their reasoning or tool loops.
OpenCursor is a complete VS Code AI coding agent integrating LLMs with tools (file edits, terminal, search), semantic retrieval, MCP, and subagents to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks.
Desktop pet that monitors and visualizes the state of external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) via hooks and log polling, without itself using an LLM.
LobsterAI is a complete Electron desktop agent app using OpenClaw runtime with tools, memory, skills, MCP, scheduled tasks, and IM channels to execute multi-step office tasks.
Provides a CLI, MCP server, and agent skills giving external AI agents programmatic access to Gemini Notebook; it is not itself an agent with LLM-driven planning.
Nexent is a complete platform that generates and runs LLM-based agents with tools, skills, memory, and orchestration for multi-step tasks, deployable via Docker or Kubernetes.
A Python reflection-based LLM translation workflow (translate, reflect, improve) with multi-step LLM calls; a complete demo agentic application despite being immature, with usage examples.

Agent Laboratory is a complete end-to-end multi-agent LLM research workflow using external tools (arXiv, Hugging Face, Python, LaTeX) to plan and execute literature review, experiments, and report writing.
PySpur is a complete visual platform for building and running LLM agent workflows, with tool calling, memory loops, RAG, human-in-the-loop, tracing, evals, and deployment as API.
MaiBot (MaiSaka) is a complete LLM-based chat agent that decides when to speak, learns slang, and uses memory and retrieval to interact in group conversations.

Repository hosts source code and workflows for many complete open-source LLM agents (n8n and Python) on the Live Agent Studio, so it delivers working agentic applications despite also being a curated collection.

RL framework that wraps a self-hosted model as an OpenAI-compatible API for OpenClaw, training the external agent's policy from conversations; it is infrastructure for another agent, not itself an agentic app.
1Code is a desktop client/UI around external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex), providing presentation, git worktree management and monitoring rather than its own agent implementation.

ClawTeam is a multi-agent swarm orchestrator that spawns CLI coding agents, delegates tasks, and coordinates them toward a goal. It could also be read as infrastructure for external agents, but recall favors inclusion.

ComfyUI-Copilot is an LLM-powered assistant that generates, debugs, and optimizes ComfyUI workflows using retrieval of a workflow library and model search/download, performing multi-step tasks as a complete application.

MineContext is a complete desktop app that uses LLMs with screen capture, memory/storage, and retrieval to proactively generate summaries, todos, and insights through multi-step context-engineering pipelines.

Ouroboros is a standalone engine (CLI plus MCP server) that uses LLM runtimes for a Socratic interview, seed spec, staged evaluation and budgeted evolution loop, so it plans and executes multi-step tasks.
TaskingAI is a complete BaaS platform with a console, where LLM assistants integrate tools, RAG retrieval, and conversation memory to run multi-step tasks, deployable as agent applications.
Kodu/Claude Coder is a complete autonomous coding agent VS Code extension using an LLM with tools (file editing, web search, deployment) to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks.
A trilingual learning roadmap with curated resources, staged lessons, and small exercises; it is teaching/reference material rather than a complete agentic application.
Kode is a standalone terminal AI coding agent that uses LLMs with an extensible tool system, context management, and skills to edit files, run commands, and execute multi-step workflows.
Complete AI creation canvas app with LLM canvas assistant, local Canvas Agent via MCP, and multi-step image/video generation workflows; also ships plugins, satisfying the agentic application rule.
AutoRAG 2.0 is a complete librarian agent built on Pi that uses an LLM with multi-method retrieval, memory, and bash to search, verify, and curate answers across multiple steps.
OASIS is a complete LLM-agent social media simulator where agents with memory and tools take multi-step actions on simulated platforms, so it qualifies as a research/demo agentic application.
Kiln is a complete desktop app with an AI Assistant that proposes improvements, runs experiments, and creates evals, and it supports agents, tools, and RAG, so it qualifies as an agentic application.
brv is a complete interactive REPL agent with 20 LLM providers, 24 built-in tools, and a memory/context tree, planning and executing multi-step coding tasks itself.
PPTAgent and DeepPresenter are LLM-driven, multi-step, reflective PowerPoint generation systems, so rule 1 applies even though the current branch also ships a skill for external coding agents.

Repository provides modular SKILL.md-based skills (PPT, Excel analysis, research, infographics) meant to run inside external agent runtimes like OpenClaw and hermes-agent, not a standalone agentic app.
ACI.dev is an open-source platform providing 600+ tool integrations, auth, and a unified MCP server for other agents to call; it is infrastructure rather than a standalone agent.
OpenAgents is a full-stack platform with hosted web UI and three complete LLM agents (Data, Plugins, Web) that use code execution, tools, and plugins to carry out multi-step tasks.
Mistral Vibe is a complete CLI coding agent that integrates Mistral LLMs with file, shell, grep, todo, and subagent tools to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks.
Integuru is a complete LLM-driven agent that analyzes HAR files, iteratively builds a request dependency graph using multi-step reasoning, and generates runnable integration code via a CLI.
Repo delivers agent skills and a CLI for Claude Code/Codex to generate images, plus a prompt gallery; it is tooling for external agents, not a standalone agentic app.
Agentic LLM for autonomous data science, with WebUI demos that run code in a sandbox to plan and execute multi-step data analysis and report generation.

A.I.G is a full-stack AI red teaming platform with Agent Scan and LLM-driven jailbreak evaluation that performs multi-step scanning tasks; it also ships skills, which don't change the complete-application classification.

Agenta is a complete open-source workspace where LLM-powered agents with memory, skills, connected-app tools, and automations plan and execute multi-step tasks, accessible via web, Slack, Telegram, and WhatsApp.
RAGapp is a complete, Docker-deployable Agentic RAG application built on LlamaIndex, with admin UI, chat UI and API, integrating LLMs with retrieval to answer enterprise queries.
Ships a complete LangGraph agent with tools, long-term memory, and supervisor, served via FastAPI and a Streamlit chat app, making it a full working agentic application despite also being a template.
Cognita is a complete RAG application with a query service, retrievers, LLM integration, indexing jobs and a frontend UI; given the recall priority, it is kept as agentic rather than excluded.
gptme is a complete LLM-powered terminal agent with shell, Python, browser, and file-editing tools, memory-like lessons, and multi-step self-correcting execution, plus TUI and web UIs.
A React visual annotation toolbar plus MCP server that gives external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) structured feedback and selectors; it contains no LLM-driven agent of its own.

Jupyter AI is a JupyterLab chat UI and client that connects external ACP agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, etc.) to notebooks. The agents themselves are external, so it presents and permissions them rather than being the agent.
CoStrict is a complete AI coding assistant (VS Code, CLI, JetBrains) that integrates LLMs with MCP tools, RAG, skills, and orchestrator modes to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks.
Micro Agent is a complete CLI agent that uses an LLM to generate tests, run them, and iteratively rewrite code until the tests pass, a multi-step loop with tool feedback.
WeRSS is a conventional FastAPI/Vue app for scraping WeChat official accounts into RSS and exports; the README shows no LLM-driven planning, so any AI Agent mention is incidental.
OptiLLM is a complete LLM inference proxy that runs multi-step techniques (MoA, MCTS, planning) with plugins for memory, retrieval, and MCP tools, so it fits the agentic definition.
Pi Web is a browser UI client around the external pi coding agent, sharing its config and sessions, rather than being a standalone agentic application itself.
Kiro is an agentic IDE, but this repo only hosts the issue tracker and triage automation, not the product source, so the evidence conflicts.
Archestra is a complete enterprise AI platform with an internal chat assistant, MCP apps, agent triggers (Slack/Teams/email), LLM and MCP gateways, and orchestration of tool-using LLM agents.
AutoHedge is a complete multi-agent LLM system (Director, Quant, Risk, Execution agents) using live market data and trading tools to plan and execute multi-step autonomous trades.
microfeed is a CMS with no built-in LLM; its official @microfeed/cli and AI-agent guide let external coding agents deploy and manage content, which is the agent-facing deliverable.
Complete Lovable-style web app builder that drives CLI coding agents to plan and generate code, with live preview, GitHub, Vercel and Supabase integration; it goes beyond a thin wrapper.
AI-DLC supplies workflow rules, agents, hooks, and a CLI installer that steer external coding harnesses (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, Cursor); it is not a standalone agentic application.

Provides commands, skills, and scheduled agents that give Claude Code and other CLI agents persistent memory in an Obsidian vault; it extends external agents rather than being a standalone agentic app.

Workspace, launcher CLI and desktop dashboard that connect and manage external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw) in a shared collaboration space, rather than being a standalone LLM agent itself.
DocETL is a complete LLM-powered system with an agentic optimizer, orchestrated multi-step map/reduce pipelines, and the DocWrangler UI, so it counts as an agentic application.

The repo contains the full Claude Code CLI source, a complete LLM-based coding agent with tool-calling, MCP, memory, and multi-agent orchestration, even though it is a leaked backup with documentation.
Hands-on RL curriculum/book with companion experiment code (PPO, DQN, DPO, GRPO), primarily teaching material rather than a complete agentic application.
PilotDeck is a complete open-source agent operating system with a Web UI, WorkSpaces, editable memory, smart model routing, and multi-agent collaboration for executing multi-step tasks.
Despite serving as an MCP tool hub for other clients, it ships a standalone web chat with its own agent loop, tools, memory, and browser/desktop automation, making it a complete agentic application.

PosterAgent is a complete multi-agent LLM/VLM system with visual-in-the-loop planning that converts paper PDFs into editable PPTX posters, with logo search and a Gradio demo, despite also including a benchmark.
Hooks, skills, sub-agents, MCP execution and memory/handoff infrastructure that extend Claude Code as the external agent, rather than a standalone agentic application.

DimOS is an agent-native robotics OS with built-in LLM agents, MCP, spatial memory RAG, perception, and navigation, delivering runnable blueprints where agents plan and execute multi-step physical tasks.

Repository delivers many complete n8n workflow templates (e.g., deep research agent, prescription agent, lead generation) that integrate LLMs with tools and retrieval to run multi-step tasks, plus MCP servers.
Package registry and comparison platform whose main agent-facing deliverable is an MCP server with tools for AI coding assistants; scoring is formula-based, not an LLM-driven agent.
Tracecat is a complete security automation platform where users build LLM agents with tools, MCP, subagents, and skills, integrated with workflows and case management to execute multi-step tasks.
Repository is an Agent Skill (methodology, prompts, examples) installed into external agent clients for stock research; it ships no standalone LLM application of its own.
Mobile app that integrates LLMs with MCP servers, plugins, and web search, and lets users create agents with tools and approval flows, making it a complete agentic application.
Biomni's A1 agent is a complete general-purpose biomedical agent combining LLM reasoning, retrieval-augmented planning, and code execution to autonomously carry out multi-step research tasks.
Besides serving as an MCP server for external agents, PromptX Desktop ships its own agent platform with roles, tools and cognitive memory, so it likely counts as a complete agentic application.

gnhf is an autonomous orchestrator that loops an LLM agent with persistent notes memory, git commit and rollback, and retries to complete multi-step objectives unattended; it is more than a thin wrapper.

AgentBench is primarily a benchmark/evaluation framework for LLM agents across environments (ALFWorld, DBBench, OS, WebShop, KG), delivering evaluation artifacts rather than a standalone agentic application.

RAPTOR is an autonomous security research framework chaining static analysis, LLM-powered vulnerability validation, exploit generation, and patch writing into multi-step workflows with its own launcher, so it is a complete agentic application.

TinyAGI is a complete multi-agent orchestration application using LLM providers (Claude, Codex) with persistent sessions, team handoffs, queues, plugins, and multi-channel interfaces, executing multi-step collaborative tasks.
Expect is a CLI that reads git changes, uses an LLM agent to generate a test plan, then runs it with Playwright browser tools in multiple steps. It also ships as a skill.
Raven is a complete multi-agent host application with built-in research, coding, design, and oncall agents. It uses LLMs with memory (EverOS), tools, and DAG planning to orchestrate multi-step tasks.
MetaClaw is a full system that combines an LLM proxy with skill injection, memory, LLM-driven skill evolution, and an RL scheduler, though it also works with external agents like OpenClaw.
Desktop app that captures traffic and uses an LLM with two-phase analysis, multi-turn follow-ups, and MCP client integration to produce reverse-engineering reports; it also exposes an MCP server.

LangWatch is open-source infrastructure (observability, agent testing, evaluations, AI gateway, MCP server, governance) that other agents and coding assistants plug into, not a standalone agentic application.
MIRIX is a complete multi-agent personal assistant with LLM-driven memory agents, screen tracking, retrieval, and a backend plus dashboard, so it qualifies as an agentic application.
A complete Electron app that lets Claude 3.5 Sonnet use computer-use tools to control the local computer and execute multi-step tasks from user prompts.
Devon is a complete LLM-powered coding agent with its own backend and terminal/UI clients, performing multi-step tasks like multi-file editing, codebase exploration, and bug fixing using tools.

Masterclass repo contains many complete runnable LLM agent applications with tools, memory, and retrieval (e.g., RAG, task-management agents), alongside teaching material, so the agentic-app rule takes precedence.
A conventional CLI for running and managing QA Wolf flows locally and in CI; AI test generation lives in the separate platform, so the CLI itself is not an LLM-driven agentic app.
It is an Agent Skill package (prompts, references, starter components) that runs inside external agents like Cursor or Claude Code, rather than a standalone agentic application.
CCB is a TUI/workspace and mobile controller that launches and coordinates other CLI coding agents (Codex, Claude, Gemini) visibly, acting as a presentation and launcher layer around external agents.
A complete terminal coding agent using Grok LLMs with web/X search tools, sub-agents, computer-use, and Telegram remote control to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks.
II-Agent is a complete open-source LLM agent app with backend and frontend that performs multi-step research, planning, and building of websites, mobile apps, and media using tools.
It describes itself as a coding agent skill, with config files and slash commands that run inside Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI to build a wiki. It ships no standalone LLM application.
Complete app that generates AI images and videos with trained LoRA models, schedules posts to social media, and offers agentic flows to automate the process via schedule or API.
nexu is a desktop client/launcher that bridges the external OpenClaw agent to IM channels like WeChat, Feishu, Slack and Discord, providing GUI setup and presentation around another agent.
Although it is a teaching repo, its runnable sections build a complete LLM agent gateway with tools, memory, skills, channels, scheduling and retries, so rule 1 applies.

Self-hosted AI chat platform for teams, with conversation management, billing, plugins and moderation; it is a complete LLM application, though the README gives little evidence of tool use or multi-step planning, so recall priority applies.

An MCP server that lets external agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) query NotebookLM notebooks, ingest sources and read citations; it is infrastructure for other agents, not a standalone agentic app.
Maestro is a desktop command center that launches, monitors, and orchestrates external agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.) rather than integrating an LLM itself.

OpenScience is a complete research agent app (desktop, browser, CLI) integrating LLMs with shell, Python/R kernels, retrieval connectors, and subagent workers to plan and execute multi-step research tasks.
Repository contains the full source of Claude Code, an LLM-driven CLI coding agent with tools, memory, MCP and multi-step task execution, so it is a complete agentic application.
LazyCodex is a plugin distribution (skills, hooks, MCP, agent roles, config) installed into Codex, an external agent, rather than a standalone agentic application.
A pi skill/CLI that lets external AI agents control the user's live Chrome session via CDP; it contains no LLM-driven agent of its own.
A complete AI video editing agent with LLM-powered planning, tool orchestration, media search, and a live demo, performing multi-step video creation tasks through natural language interaction.
AGiXT is a complete platform integrating LLMs from multiple providers with memory, 40+ extensions/tools, and workflow automation to execute multi-step tasks via natural language.
Repo is a set of markdown skills plus a Python memory API that external agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) run to maintain an Obsidian wiki; it has no standalone LLM-driven application.

Self-hostable platform integrating LLMs with retrieval over knowledge graphs and 50+ connectors, offering deep research, no-code agents, and actions across enterprise tools; a complete agentic application.
Postgres MCP Pro is an MCP server providing database tools (index tuning, explain plans, health checks, safe SQL execution) for external AI agents; it is not itself an agent.
An unofficial Suno API wrapper with GPTs/Coze action schemas, designed as a tool/plugin for LLM agents to call; it contains no LLM-driven agent itself.
TuriX is a complete computer-use agent: a VLM-driven planner and brain executes multi-step desktop tasks using skills and MCP, alongside OpenClaw skill packages and benchmark results.
An MCP server exposing LinkedIn profile, company, job, and messaging tools for external AI agents like Claude to call; it is not itself an agentic application.

Squad is a complete CLI and SDK that orchestrates persistent multi-agent teams (lead, frontend, backend, tester) with file-based memory and shared decisions, executing multi-step coding tasks through GitHub Copilot.
OSWorld is primarily a benchmark and evaluation environment (tasks, VMs, evaluators) for multimodal agents, not a complete agentic application itself.
HolmesGPT is a complete open-source SRE agent that uses LLMs in an agentic loop with toolsets for observability data to investigate incidents, plus an operator mode for background health checks.
claude-tap is a local proxy and trace viewer that intercepts and inspects API traffic from external coding agents; it is tooling for them rather than an LLM-driven agentic app itself.
Next.js chat client that connects to any external LangGraph server; it is a presentation interface around other agents and does not implement its own agent logic.

GenOffice is a complete desktop AI office suite with a built-in LLM agent that reads and edits documents, spreadsheets and slides, with search/retrieval and snapshots; it also ships a CLI, MCP and skill.
JiuwenSwarm is a complete multi-agent system with leader/teammate LLM agents, tool invocation, skill self-evolution, and workflows, delivered as desktop, CLI, and chat-app interfaces.
Chaterm is a complete AI terminal application with an LLM agent that plans and executes multi-step infrastructure tasks using tools, long-term memory, and a knowledge base for retrieval.
It is an Agent Skill and Claude Code plugin that lets external coding agents write and run Playwright browser automation; it is not a standalone agentic application.
A deployable web app (AgentGPT-style) where an LLM autonomously plans and executes multi-step tasks toward user goals, so it is a complete agentic application.
A portable agentskills.io skill that other agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Hermes) load to audit and rewrite text; it is not a standalone agentic application.
The open-source repo delivers a notebook file format, converters, blocks, and IDE extensions for Jupyter-style notebooks; the Deepnote AI agent belongs to the closed cloud product, not this repo.

Mercury is a complete LLM-driven agent with built-in tools, SQLite-backed Second Brain memory, skills, and multi-channel access (CLI, Telegram, Discord, Slack), planning and executing multi-step tasks with permission controls.
Letta Code is a complete stateful LLM agent harness with CLI, desktop app, and messaging interfaces, featuring persistent memory, skills, and tools for multi-step tasks.
Ships a runnable multi-turn CLI chatbot (bot.py) that orchestrates layered LLM agents with aggregation, a complete demo app, though it also includes benchmark evaluation scripts.

Mini Agent is a complete LLM-driven agent with an execution loop, file/shell tools, persistent session memory, context summarization, MCP and skills integration, running multi-step tasks as a runnable demo app.
Ralphy is a complete autonomous coding loop that drives LLM coding agents through PRD task lists, config rules, and multi-step execution until done, which is more than a thin launcher.
PentestAgent is a complete LLM-driven pentesting application with a TUI, terminal and browser tools, Docker/Kali environments, and async multi-step task execution.
Security scanner CLI that inspects agents, MCP servers, and skills for vulnerabilities; it serves other agents' ecosystems rather than being an agentic application itself.

The repository bundles complete runnable LLM apps, including multi-agent research assistant with memory/retrieval, financial analyst agents, and a news digest agent, so Rule 1 applies despite its curated-collection framing.

MiniAGI is a complete autonomous LLM agent using GPT models with tools (shell, Python execution), short-term memory with summarization, chain-of-thought, and a critic to plan and execute multi-step tasks.
Kiro Crew is a full agent workspace with a Gateway, persistent memory, self-learning skills, schedules, heartbeats, and unattended multi-step tasks, going beyond a thin wrapper around kiro-cli.
RL training framework with scripts, hyperparameter tuning, and pre-trained RL agents; no LLM integration, so it is conventional ML software rather than an LLM-based agentic application.
A background daemon bridging Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ and WeChat to Claude Code/Codex, serving as a chat interface and client around external coding agents rather than its own agent.
Complete multi-agent LLM investment research system with tool-using analysts, bull/bear debate, trader and risk managers, runnable via pip install and a Web UI, using A-share data tools.
Documentation platform that ships a built-in AI chat over the catalog, using retrieval and tools, plus an MCP server. The LLM integration is borderline, but I leaned toward inclusion.
It is an MCP/A2A gateway and registry that gives external copilots and agents secure, governed access to enterprise tools. The README shows no LLM-driven application of its own.
Standalone AI penetration-testing agent that uses LLMs with MCP tools, evidence memory, and an autonomous loop to run multi-step recon, exploitation, and report generation.
Mobile-use is a complete open-source LLM-powered agent that controls Android/iOS devices via natural language, planning and executing multi-step UI tasks using tools such as the accessibility tree.
Repository is a collection of agents, skills, commands, hooks, plugins, and MCP configs for Claude Code to use; it is not a standalone agentic application.

The cookbook includes complete deployed demo apps (e.g., viet-bike-scout, tutor-finder) that use parallel TinyFish web agents to plan and execute multi-step browser tasks, despite also being a recipe collection.
Argent provides tools, MCP-style capabilities, and skills that let external AI assistants control, debug, and profile iOS/Android apps; it is not itself an agent.
A complete desktop AI agent app integrating LLMs with MCP tools, skills, sandboxed file operations, and GUI automation to execute multi-step tasks, not merely a wrapper around another agent.
macOS-use is a complete agent app where an LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) controls macOS apps and UI to plan and execute multi-step tasks from natural-language prompts.
Desktop app with its own custom agent loop, multi-model LLM support, tools, and plan/exec modes for running parallel coding agents in isolated workspaces; a complete agentic application.

The generator produces a complete full-stack app with LLM agents (Pydantic AI, LangChain), tool calls, RAG retrieval, and streaming chat UI; the generated app itself is a runnable agentic application.

Repository delivers two complete computer-use agents (Playwright JS and PyAutoGUI Python) using the Responses API with a console, running multi-step tasks via tool execution and screenshot feedback loops.
A desktop app where users build and run LLM agent loops with tools, trace and replay steps, evaluate, and AI-generate prompts, tools, and LangGraph agents, so it is a complete agentic app.
Complete desktop and mobile app that runs LLM coding agents with MCP tools, task trackers, worktrees, and a built-in AI assistant, going beyond a pure wrapper around another agent.
A complete autonomous pipeline using LLMs to discover, score, tailor resumes, write cover letters, and drive a browser to submit job applications across multi-step tasks.

Notes app with 'Ask your notes' feature where an LLM queries and retrieves from the user's notes with cited sources via user-provided API keys, plus a CLI for agents; recall priority favors inclusion.
An on-device GUI agent that reads screenshots and executes multi-step Android tasks. It ships as a model with inference code, so it is borderline with Models, but I lean toward inclusion.
A CLI that runs tasks through multi-step workflow loops, with LLM mentor evaluation and compiled experience records reused as memory, so it appears to be a complete agentic system.

Complete iMessage personal agent built on Claude Agent SDK or Codex runtime, with memory, sub-agents, automations, and Composio integrations; despite being described as a template, it is a working agentic app.
Kanban is a local web UI that launches, monitors, and reviews diffs for external CLI agents in parallel worktrees, wrapping other agents rather than being its own LLM agent.

A complete browser-based desktop with a built-in LLM agent that operates multiple apps via a structured Action system, reading data and updating state to execute multi-step tasks from natural language.

Besides the static config scanner, it ships an Opus-based multi-agent deep analysis pipeline and MiniClaw, an agent runtime. Under rule 1 and the recall priority, that makes it an agentic application.
Cali is a standalone CLI with its own LLM agent using bounded tool packs (agent-device, react-devtools, repo-read/write) to run multi-step QA, review, perf-review, and dev tasks.
A Next.js voice frontend client that connects to a separate LiveKit agent; it provides the presentation interface rather than the agent's own LLM logic, tools, or memory.
Companion kit offering installable agent skills, example CAD models, and docs for ForgeCAD; the core app lives elsewhere, so this repo mainly supplies skills and examples for external agents.
A dashboard that monitors and launches Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex sessions; it is a presentation/monitoring client around external agents, with an MCP sidecar but no own LLM-driven agent.
README describes two minimal starter apps as reference implementations of ChatKit integrations, i.e. incomplete starter templates rather than a finished agentic application.

A full-stack all-in-one web app that integrates ChatGPT/OpenAI SDK, MCP services and Agent features for chat, paper retrieval, and a Xianyu assistant that auto-replies and ships orders, so rule 1 applies.
Electron desktop GUI that is explicitly a shell around the pi coding agent runtime, not a separate agent; sessions, models, and tools all run through pi itself.

It is a complete Manager/Executor/Auditor loop that plans, acts, verifies, and checkpoints durable state for multi-step computer-use tasks, with its own CLI and browser runner, not just a thin wrapper.
Complete platform integrating LLMs with RAG retrieval, tools, and CrewAI multi-agent backend to build and deploy chat and multi-agent process automation apps.
AppAgentX is a complete LLM-based GUI agent that controls Android devices via ADB, with a memory mechanism and evolving high-level actions, plus a runnable demo.
No model call: no README in repository.

VS Code extension for discovering and installing MCP servers and agent skills for external agents (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex); it provides tooling infrastructure rather than being a complete agentic app itself.
Avibe is a browser and chat-app front end that routes tasks to the official Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents, and the README says it adds no reasoning loop of its own.
An MCP server exposing remote macOS mouse/keyboard/screen control tools for external agents like Claude Desktop; it contains no LLM or agent loop of its own.

AppWorld is primarily a benchmark and execution environment (9 apps, 457 APIs, tasks) for evaluating function-calling and interactive coding agents; it provides only a minimal example agent, not a complete agentic application.

taOS is a complete self-hosted AI agent OS with agent memory (taOSmd), multi-framework group chat, web desktop and app store, integrating LLMs with memory and tools, favoring inclusion under recall priority.
Shadscan is a deterministic, read-only CLI linter for shadcn UI audits that makes no LLM calls by default; it only emits prompts for external coding agents.
Shinkai is a complete desktop app for building and running LLM-powered agents with MCP tools, multi-agent orchestration, and multi-step workflows, using local or remote models.
CoWork OS is a complete desktop agentic application integrating LLMs with tools, memory, browser, automations, and approvals to execute multi-step tasks, plus a CLI.
Agentok Studio is a complete visual studio app with a chat interface and backend that builds and runs multi-agent AG2 LLM workflows with tools, a deployable full-stack application.

Mainly a WeChat gateway to Codex, but it also adds its own agents, automation, assistant records, approvals and provider-profile switching, so it is likely a full agentic system rather than a thin wrapper.
Abu is a complete local desktop AI agent app that plans, uses tools (files, commands, browser), runs multi-agent tasks, memory/skills, and schedules, so it is an agentic application.
REA is an MCP server and CLI giving external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) reverse-engineering tools; it is not itself an agent with an LLM planning loop.
A CLI and MCP server giving external AI agents authenticated access to 750+ platforms, plus workflow tooling; it supplies infrastructure for other agents rather than being a standalone agentic app.
A complete CLI where an LLM (Gemini, GPT, Claude) sees the device screen and performs multi-step mobile QA actions autonomously, producing pass/fail reports; it also ships skills for other agents.
A desktop and Android GUI client around the existing pi coding agent SDK, sharing its sessions and settings; it presents timeline, review and terminal views rather than being a new agent.
Full-stack chat app with an OpenAI-powered writing assistant agent that uses Tavily web search as a tool and manages agent lifecycles, making it a complete agentic application.
Vite/Webpack/Next.js plugin and MCP tools that give coding agents source-aware UI context; it supplies infrastructure for external agents rather than being an agentic application itself.

NextClaw is a self-hosted AI agent workspace with its own native runtime, memory, skills, scheduled tasks, and tool use for multi-step work, in addition to supporting external runtimes like Codex and Claude Code.
AppCopilot is a complete mobile agent driven by multimodal foundation models that controls Android devices or emulators via ADB, running multi-step tasks through run_agent.py.
A JSON-only Linear CLI with token-efficient usage discovery, designed for AI agents to call as a tool; it is not itself an LLM-driven application.
Dorabot is a complete macOS app where an LLM agent uses memory, scheduling, browser automation, messaging channels and MCP tools to plan and execute multi-step goals autonomously.
Includes complete LLM-based apps like a chat agent with tool-calling, long-term memory, RAG proxy, and wake-word voice assistant, so it qualifies despite also shipping servers and utilities.
A complete web app with a generative UI that runs a LangGraph computer-use agent (OpenAI model plus Scrapybara VM tools) to plan and execute multi-step tasks.
A CLI framework that uses LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) as autonomous agents to plan and generate complete full-stack SaaS apps from a description, a complete agentic application.

Complete self-hostable team AI platform (Next.js/Node) integrating multiple LLMs with custom agents, prompts, file/data-backed Brains for retrieval, and workflows; a full application, not a wrapper or template.
A conventional desktop media-library scraper and browser for NFO and cover art; LLMs are used only incidentally for translation, and the REST API merely lets external AI tools drive it.

Desktop app that hosts and manages multiple external AI agent sessions (terminals, editor, git worktrees) in one window; it presents and orchestrates other agents rather than implementing its own LLM agent.
A complete desktop app built on the Claude Agent SDK that bundles runtimes and skills so the LLM agent can execute code, manage files, and perform multi-step tasks.
A complete open-source chat app using the AI SDK with LLMs and Pipedream MCP tools to discover and execute multi-step API tool calls, with persistence and auth.
An MCP server exposing Apache Superset operations (dashboards, charts, SQL Lab) for external AI agents like Claude Desktop and Cursor to use; it contains no agent of its own.
Pagecast is a publishing tool with an agent skill and Claude Code plugin that lets coding agents publish reports; it contains no LLM-driven application of its own.
Complete platform where an LLM agent drives a real browser, plans and runs multi-step end-to-end tests, uses tools and codebase context, and reviews PRs with results.
Selene is a complete desktop app running LLM agents with tools, memory, retrieval, browser control, and deep research to execute multi-step tasks, connected to messaging platforms.
SweetLink is a CLI and daemon that lets external coding agents drive a real browser session, capture screenshots and read DevTools telemetry; it contains no LLM-driven agent of its own.
Desktop Electron/Next.js app integrating LLMs with web search, MCP tools, and multi-agent workflow execution for multi-step browser and file tasks, a complete agentic application.
Complete application where LLM agents scrape Upwork jobs, score and filter them, and generate cover letters and interview prep via multi-step workflow with scraping tools.
GhostDesk is an MCP server giving external LLM agents desktop control (screen, mouse, keyboard, apps); it is infrastructure for other agents, not itself an agent application.
A macOS floating-window prompt input client for external CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI); it presents an interface around them and has no LLM agent of its own.
Desktop GUI that visualizes, configures, deploys, and schedules Claude Code agent teams; it is a presentation and launcher client around an external agent (Claude Code) rather than its own agent.
A complete storefront chat assistant: a backend that calls Claude and acts as an MCP client to run multi-step shopping tasks (search, cart, checkout, orders), plus a chat UI extension.
Loopsy is a mobile app and relay for remotely controlling terminals running external agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex; it is a presentation client and launcher, not an agent itself.

Self-hostable health app where LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama) parse uploaded records and chat grounded on stored medical data, combining LLM, retrieval of health data, and multi-step parsing workflows.
Browser extension and MCP server let users annotate pages so external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) can implement fixes; the repo itself contains no LLM-driven agent.

DocMason is a repo-native agent app that uses an LLM runtime (Codex/ChatGPT/Claude Code) with local retrieval, provenance tracing, and a knowledge base to perform multi-step deep research over office documents.

Complete Streamlit multimodal RAG app combining Llama-3.2 LLM/VLM, NIM microservices, and a Milvus vector store for retrieval-based chat over documents, matching the recall-favoring inclusion criterion.
Main deliverable is a portable set of 15 Claude Code commands and 2 skills plus methodology; the poll demo app is a conventional non-LLM app, so not agentic.
A complete middleware app using OpenAI's Realtime API with Twilio Voice/Flex/TaskRouter to intercept, translate, and speak audio live between caller and agent, orchestrating multi-step call flows.

A complete voice chat app that streams OpenAI responses with Deepgram speech I/O. Its description cites Exa retrieval, and it ships an MCP/CLI harness. Agentic status is borderline, so I favor inclusion.
Complete local-first knowledge app with CLI, dashboard, and Viki Q&A where LLM agents ingest, distill, retrieve, and maintain a wiki over multiple steps; the skill is an optional adapter.
Hook scripts that let Claude Code and Codex route risky-action approvals and completion notifications to Apple Watch; it is infrastructure for external agents, not an agent itself.

Complete sample app with FastAPI backend and web UI orchestrating multiple LLM agents (Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure OpenAI, Cosmos DB, document retrieval) for multi-step investment analysis and what-if chat.

Spectral is a complete app whose LLM-driven pipeline analyzes captured traffic, generates MCP tools and self-repairs them at runtime. It also serves tools to external agents, but the LLM pipeline qualifies under rule 1.
FrontAgent is a complete LLM-powered coding agent (CLI, VS Code extension, desktop app) with RAG planning, MCP tools, browser automation, and multi-step planning/execution under SDD guardrails.
An MCP server exposing Auth0 Management API tools for external LLM clients like Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf to use; it is not itself an agent.
Complete local-first job application agent with LLM layer, auditable agent traces, bounded tools, job search, fit scoring, material generation, form filling, human-gated submission, and tracking.
A complete voice AI assistant starter built on LiveKit Agents with an LLM, STT/TTS pipeline, tool calls and handoffs; described as a complete app, so it counts as an agentic application.

Complete macOS daemon that connects LLM CLIs to Apple apps (iMessage, Mail, Reminders, Notes, Calendar, Pages, Numbers) with approval gates and tool flows for multi-step tasks, going beyond a thin wrapper.
Lumina is a complete desktop agent application integrating LLMs with persistent memory, ~90 tools, sandboxed code execution, sub-agents, and multi-step task execution.
MMSP is an SDK/protocol library giving developers a unified LLM interface with tracing, plus SKILL files for coding agents; it is infrastructure, not a complete agentic application.
A complete prompt-to-web-app builder using OpenAI agents with E2B sandbox tools, Inngest orchestration, and persistence to plan and execute multi-step code generation tasks.

Hearth is a complete desktop app that includes its own playtester agent. The agent plays games in a browser and keeps persistent memory notes across sessions, alongside the bring-your-own coding agent integration.
A Windows installer and native desktop shell that bundles, configures, updates, and launches the existing OpenClaw agent framework, rather than implementing its own agent logic.
AppClaw is a complete LLM-driven mobile automation agent that reads the screen, reasons, and executes multi-step tasks via appium-mcp tools on Android and iOS devices.
Houston is a complete desktop/web/cloud app with pre-built LLM agents using real tools and 1000+ integrations to perform multi-step tasks, running on its own pi runtime engine.
Dim0 is a complete collaborative canvas app with a board-aware LLM agent that uses tools, RAG over documents, and multi-step actions to write results back onto the board.
MindRoot is a complete self-hostable agent platform with web UI, agent loop, tool dispatch, RAG/memory, and plugins, integrating LLMs with tools and memory to execute multi-step tasks.

Desktop app that runs Claude Code and Codex and adds its own Modify agent, which plans and edits the app's UI with diff gating and rollback. It is borderline with a wrapper, but I leaned toward inclusion.
A browser extension plus local MCP server that captures UI annotations and exports structured context for external AI coding agents to consume; it contains no LLM-driven agent itself.
PawWork is a complete desktop AI agent app with an LLM, built-in web search, Office skills, workspace file tools, and scheduled automations that execute multi-step tasks.

Desktop workspace that runs Claude (Agent SDK) and Cursor agents with durable memory, search, permissions, and worktrees for multi-step coding tasks. It disclaims being an agent itself, but leans toward inclusion per recall priority.
Primarily a compliance playbook delivering an agent audit skill, rule, and pre-submission guard hook for Claude Code to use; no standalone LLM-driven application is present.

Dossier is a complete application that uses an Anthropic LLM with a vector store for memory and retrieval, and git and test tooling, to plan, dispatch, build, and ship multi-step feature work via agents.
Clutch is a complete desktop app running LangGraph multi-agent workflows locally with LLMs, tools, MCP, and an agent with terminal tool use, supporting multi-step task execution.
Desktop Electron app integrating LLMs with built-in map tools, MCP servers, and a RAG knowledge base to perform geospatial analysis tasks via chat.
Complete Streamlit app with login that runs a LangChain pandas agent on GPT-4, with chat memory, over user-selected stock data to answer questions and analyze it.

A complete Next.js wizard app using OpenAI chat with context carried across steps to generate multi-step spec documents (one-pager, dev spec, prompt plan, AGENTS.md); it is a deployed LLM application.
Desktop app built on Claude Agent SDK with per-project memory, skills, sub-agents, tool use, IM bridge and scheduled tasks, making it a complete agentic application rather than only a client wrapper.
Electron desktop app wrapping Claude Code and Codex CLI with terminal tabs, file browser, settings and update management; it presents and launches external agents without its own agent logic.
A complete novel-writing app using LLMs with multi-agent orchestration, tool selection, and multi-level review to plan and execute multi-step story generation, producing full manuscripts.
Complete CrewAI program with three LLM agents doing multi-step internet research, delivered as a web app, so it qualifies as a research/demo agentic application.
Math Wiz is a complete Chainlit chatbot using a LangChain agent with an OpenAI LLM that selects among tools to answer arithmetic and reasoning questions.

A complete cross-platform demo app that runs realtime Grok voice-agent conversations with streaming transcripts. Tool use isn't shown in the excerpt, but the memory note favors including borderline agentic apps.
Full-stack job application platform integrating LLMs (LiteLLM) with browser-use/Playwright automation, FAISS retrieval, and job search tools to execute multi-step application workflows.
Full-stack app with FastAPI/Agno LLM agent backend (with frontend tools) and Next.js Vercel AI SDK chat UI, Docker-deployable, demonstrating a complete realtime agentic chat application.

A complete Streamlit app using an OpenAI LLM with a LangChain Pandas DataFrame agent, conversational memory, and tool-based code execution to answer multi-step user queries over uploaded CSV/XLSX data.
An MCP server exposing Appium mobile device control and visual element detection for external AI agents like Claude to use, rather than a standalone agentic application.
Devseeker is a complete LLM-powered coding agent that generates, edits, reviews, and runs code with memory, self-healing, and multiple modes from a prompt, so it is a standalone agentic application.
