Autospec is a complete CLI AI agent using vision/language models with browser tooling to plan, explore, execute multi-step QA of web apps, and generate Playwright tests.
EverFern is a complete desktop AI agent using LLMs via a LangGraph orchestrator with computer use, browser agent, persistent memory, tools, and skills to plan and execute multi-step tasks.
A WIP starter template for a streaming LLM chat app via OpenRouter. It has persisted conversations but no tools, retrieval, or multi-step planning, so it is not a complete agentic application.
Fork of awesome-llm-apps containing many complete runnable LLM agent apps (multi-agent teams, RAG, MCP, deep research agents) with tools and memory, despite its curated-list framing.
A complete DAW app with a built-in LLM agent (OpenAI/Gemini) that reads project state, produces multi-step edit plans for melodies, drums, mixer and FX, with preview, apply and undo.

A complete screenshot-design editor with a built-in AI agent that designs store listings by editing projects using tools (including Claude Code mode); it also ships a CLI and MCP server.

Complete multi-agent RAG application with orchestrator, retriever, writer, verifier, and curator agents using Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Search, and Foundry models, with a React web frontend and deployable infrastructure.
A complete Streamlit app where an OpenAI function-calling LangChain agent plans searches, retrieves web pages, and iterates multi-step to answer questions using DuckDuckGo and page-retrieval tools.

A full-stack AI coding assistant app (FastAPI backend, web frontend) using OpenAI/Bedrock LLMs with project directory context, focus files, and on-demand agent functions for code management.
Complete WhatsApp platform with a Gemini-based grounded AI agent that retrieves from a knowledge base and calls registered live APIs via slash commands before replying, plus a dashboard.

OpenJet is a complete terminal coding agent that uses local LLMs to edit files and run commands, bundled with its own inference runtime and SDK.
A Frappe app that integrates CrewAI, LLM providers, and tools so crews of agents execute multi-step tasks, run via UI or Python; a complete agentic system.
A Claude Code skill (plus a companion Cowork plugin) that extends Claude Code with a deploy workflow; it is a skill for an external agent, not a standalone agentic app.

A complete realtime drawing game where a LiveKit Agents-based AI agent uses vision and LLM calls to judge players and manage game state, a full demo app with agent and web frontend.

Complete multi-agent LangChain system with orchestrator, 11 specialized agents, 20+ tools, RAG pipeline, and Streamlit/REST/CLI interfaces for autonomous multi-step stock analysis and report generation.
Desktop app that manages, installs, and syncs SKILL.md packages for external coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor; it does not itself use an LLM to plan tasks.

A complete CLI that retrieves live Dynatrace gen_ai spans, masks data, scores them with an LLM judge in a multi-step pipeline, and writes results back; the LLM judge is core.

A complete web app that extracts source files from uploaded IPAs and runs a multi-provider LLM audit pipeline, streaming a compliance report; it also ships CLI wrappers, MCP and a skill.

Complete multi-agent collaboration platform where Claude-based agents with specialized roles coordinate via channels, a shared board, and tools to execute multi-step tasks alongside humans.

A local MCP server and CLI that external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) call to scan, fix and rescan code; it embeds no LLM of its own.
Desktop app built on Claude Code that adds multi-agent teams, MCP tools, persistent SQLite memory, and scheduled workflows. This goes beyond a thin wrapper, and recall favors inclusion.
Hosts existing coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Hermes) in a browser terminal on Databricks Apps, adding tracing and governance wiring rather than building its own agent.
Complete full-stack app builder where Gemini generates React apps and a Cline SDK agent with update_file/done_improving tools autonomously improves files multi-step, plus tutorial material.
Complete chat app where an LLM delegates multi-step tasks to ephemeral Docker shell and browser sub-agents with persistent workspaces; the standalone MCP server is an additional deliverable.
Complete desktop app integrating local LLMs (Ollama/llama.cpp) with persistent memory and a built-in code execution harness, supporting tool-using chat workflows; recall priority favors inclusion.
Awel is a complete AI agent app builder that uses LLMs with file/shell tools and memory to plan and execute multi-step code edits and generate whole Next.js apps.
Full-stack real estate chatbot app combining LLMs with Pinecone RAG, Neo4j GraphRAG, MCP, and LangGraph agentic workflows to deliver multi-step personalized property recommendations.

Although it is workshop material, it ships runnable LLM agent demos (ReAct, agentic RAG, blackboard, memory, code execution) that use tools, memory and retrieval for multi-step tasks, so Rule 1 applies.
A complete web app where Planner, Navigator, and Validator LLM agents use Appium tools to plan and execute multi-step mobile tasks from natural language instructions.
Self-hosted GitHub App that uses an LLM agent (PI) to read files, grep and explore the repo, and posts multi-step PR reviews; a complete agentic application.
ANA is a complete self-hosted app whose runtime is a coding agent (LLM) in tmux with tools, proposals and live evolution, planning and executing multi-step tasks; it also ships install skills.
Complete multi-agent no-code engine where an orchestrator coordinates LLM specialist agents (schema, UI, logic, query, test) using tools to build and modify data apps via conversation.

Pilot is a complete desktop app that integrates LLMs with tools, persistent memory, git, task management, and subagents to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks, rather than just wrapping an external agent.
Genesis is a complete Electron desktop agent integrating LLMs with episodic memory, planning, tool use, and sandboxed self-modification to autonomously execute multi-step goals.

A complete local app that mines Claude Code history, generates skills, loops and multi-agent workflows, and runs, schedules and monitors them via headless Claude Code. It is borderline with a wrapper, but I resolved toward recall.

A complete native RAG and Agent chat application integrating LLMs with function calling, knowledge-base retrieval, and multiple agent modes, so it qualifies as an agentic app.
Complete open-source platform with an LLM-driven Playwright browser agent that plans and executes multi-step web tests, with skills, self-healing memory, dashboard, API, and runner service.
No model call: no README in repository.

A complete Streamlit demo app running Azure AI Foundry agents that use LLMs with Code Interpreter and Bing Search tools to execute multi-step tasks.
NestMux is a desktop terminal multiplexer that hosts external AI CLIs (Claude, Codex, Gemini) in panes, serving as a presentation client and launcher rather than an agent itself.

PortOS is a complete self-hosted application with autonomous AI agent orchestration, multi-model task execution, persistent memory, second brain classification, and a digital twin, integrating LLMs with tools and memory.
A macOS menu-bar app that turns a Ting mic into a voice and button controller for external coding agents like Claude Code and Codex; it is an interface client and does not itself run an LLM agent.

Desktop app built with Langchain.js that offers LLM chat (described as multi-agent), packaged with Tauri; given the recall priority for possible agentic apps, it is classed as an agentic application.

Working newsletter-generator app with Python research and formatting LLM agents, orchestrated by Inngest for multi-step workflows, with Next.js frontend and Blob storage; although framed as a starter, it is a complete app.
A complete wiki app with a built-in LLM agent that routes pushed documents to the right pages, runs auto-organize sweeps proposing changes, and exposes MCP for external agents.
A complete Streamlit chatbot app using GPT with LangChain agents and tools to query a Postgres database of product recalls, performing multi-step SQL tasks.
opendot is a complete terminal AI agent using LLMs via LiteLLM with file/shell tools, MCP and Composio integrations, session memory, and multi-step execution with undo snapshots.
Desktop app that hosts and monitors external coding agents (Claude, Codex) in per-worktree terminals with attention tracking and diff review; it doesn't implement its own LLM agent.

A complete Streamlit app using a LangChain Pandas DataFrame Agent (LLM with tool execution) to answer user questions about uploaded CSV data via multi-step reasoning.

Palmos is a complete platform with a vibe-coding agent controlling terminals and modifying code, plus an MCP-client agentic chat and workflow canvas, integrating LLMs with tools to execute multi-step tasks.

Complete Agentic RAG system with a Pydantic AI agent using vector and hybrid search retrieval over pgvector, session memory, FastAPI backend, and Streamlit frontend, performing multi-step document question answering.
Argus is a local desktop app that reads session files from Claude and Codex agents and shows analytics on them, so it is a monitor around other agents rather than an agent itself.

Browser-based terminal that hosts existing coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) on Databricks Apps; it provides the interface and setup around external agents rather than its own agent.
Desktop app with its own coding agent, autopilot reviewer, chat memory, and video generation that executes multi-step tasks using LLMs and tools; also ships framework packages.

A complete terminal-based AI coding agent using Claude/OpenAI with tools and semantic search embeddings for multi-step coding tasks; also tutorial material, but the working app qualifies.

Besides serving as an MCP tool server, it includes an autonomous mission engine that plans, executes, retries and verifies multi-step desktop tasks, with a web UI and desktop app, so it is a complete agentic application.
Primarily a conventional Roku developer desktop app and CLI, but it ships an MCP server for AI agents; no LLM-driven app of its own is evident, so the MCP server is the agent-relevant deliverable.
A local router that adds DeepSeek to the stock ChatGPT desktop app and Codex's model picker, proxying requests around an existing agent rather than being an agent itself.
Aurict is a complete terminal AI coding agent with LLM integration, sandboxed tools, subagents, and multi-provider support to plan and execute multi-step coding tasks.

Full-stack app where users create custom AI agents that run GPT-4o meeting assistants with transcripts, summaries, context-based chat, and real-time in-call assistance via Stream and Inngest background jobs.

A local PII-redaction proxy that sits between external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenAI-compatible apps) and LLM providers. It uses local NER detection, not an LLM, so it is infrastructure for agents rather than an agentic app.

A complete Flask demo app where AutoGen LLM agents use Semantic Kernel plugins (flight lookup, time, simulated booking) and Cosmos DB to autonomously complete multi-step booking tasks.

Desktop app where an LLM agent reasons within references using tools (web search, browsing, visualizations, attached files/mail), with RAG and memory, plus Telegram remote; a complete agentic application.

Complete Streamlit app using LangChain and OpenAI to retrieve over uploaded PDFs (retrieval/RAG) with conversational memory for a chat agent, satisfying the LLM-plus-retrieval criterion.

Python physics simulation engines rendered to video via ffmpeg/manim; no LLM integration, and the AGENTS.md only guides coding agents on repo structure and credit.
A chat frontend with Fastify backend and SSO that presents and streams responses from an external Template Agent (or other agents); it is a UI client, not the agent itself.

Desktop app with a DeepAgents-based LLM agent that uses file, terminal, git, test, and training tools, with sessions, approvals, and persistent memory/RAG to plan and execute multi-step coding and fine-tuning tasks.

A complete platform that runs autonomous LLM agents in sandboxed containers with credentials, skills, MCP servers, and cron scheduling to execute multi-step tasks and return structured results.
